Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made a factual error by incorrectly concluding that "Gimme Shelter" (1970) was Oscar-nominated. In Step 6, the agent stated: "this confirms Gimme Shelter (1970) was Oscar-nominated at the 42nd Academy Awards (1970)." This conclusion was drawn from a search snippet mentioning the "Maysles Collection" and listing "Gimme Shelter" as one of their films, but the snippet did not explicitly state that the film was nominated. The agent hallucinated the nomination status based on the presence of the film in a collection page rather than finding a specific nomination record. This is a critical error because the task requires determining which film was nominated, and the agent provided false information for one of the two options. (Note: In reality, neither film was nominated; LaLee's Kin was nominated for Best Documentary Short Subject at the 74th Academy Awards in 2002, and Gimme Shelter was not nominated).
